spells.name: Dreaming
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance of a reward: 50% of successful casts grant +10 military experience, 40% grant the caster +1 permanent Martial, and 10% grant one innovation.

spells.name: Scramble
spells.effect_summary: For 180 days, the caster grants commanded heavy and light infantry +7.5% movement speed.

spells.name: Water Walker
spells.effect_summary: For 180 days, the caster grants commanded fleets +85% ship capture chance, +25% naval damage dealt, and +25% naval damage taken.

spells.name: Unified Blades
spells.effect_summary: For 180 days, the caster grants commanded heavy and light infantry +12.5% offense and +7.5% discipline.

spells.name: Golden Hands
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance to grant the country one free provincial investment. Otherwise, no investment is granted.

spells.name: Craftsman's Knowledge
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance to permanently grant the caster +1 Finesse.

spells.name: Cafea's Breath
spells.effect_summary: Removes one caster affliction, taking the first present in this order: Hunchback, Limp, Castrated, Blind, Maimed, One-Eyed, Brain Damaged. The shared caster-eligibility rule blocks casting while Brain Damaged.

spells.name: Bloodlust
spells.effect_summary: For 180 days, the caster gains +10 Martial but -12 Charisma, Finesse, and Zeal. The trait also carries country penalties of -0.02 monthly stability, -5% tax income, and -0.02 monthly province loyalty.

spells.name: Na'athran's Blessing
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance to grant the country one free provincial investment.

spells.name: Serpentine Scrying
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance to grant the country +8 military experience.

spells.name: Raging Dragon
spells.effect_summary: For 180 days, the caster grants commanded light cavalry, heavy cavalry, and horse archers +7.5% offense and +12.5% movement speed.

spells.name: Gozon's Blessing
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance to permanently grant the caster +1, +2, or +3 Zeal, with equal chances.

spells.name: Victory's Blessing
spells.effect_summary: For 180 days, the caster gains +3 Martial and commanded armies gain +25% land morale.

spells.name: Revelations of the Way
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance of a reward: +1 permanent caster Zeal, +1 permanent caster Martial, or one innovation, with equal chances.

spells.name: Kon's Wisdom
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance to permanently grant the caster +1 to one randomly selected attribute: Martial, Charisma, Finesse, or Zeal, with equal chances.

spells.name: Berserker Rage
spells.effect_summary: For 180 days, the caster gains +10 Martial but -10 Charisma, Finesse, and Zeal; commanded armies gain +5% land morale. The trait also carries country penalties of -0.02 monthly stability, -5% tax income, and -0.02 monthly province loyalty.

spells.name: Channeled Stars
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance to permanently grant the caster +1 to one randomly selected attribute: Martial, Charisma, Finesse, or Zeal, with equal chances. Otherwise, no attribute is increased.

spells.name: Ancestral Rumination
spells.effect_summary: Has a 10% chance of a reward: +8 military experience, one innovation, or +1 permanent caster Zeal, with equal chances.

spells.name: Explosion
spells.effect_summary: In an enemy-owned territory where a caster-commanded army stands, kills approximately one fifth of the pops. For 64 days, the territory also receives -50% local defensiveness, -50% garrison size, and -0.04 local population growth.

spells.name: Coils of the Serpent
spells.effect_summary: Grants the country +10% enslavement efficiency for 365 days. Recasting refreshes the duration.

spells.name: Great Flare of the Setting Sun
spells.effect_summary: Destroys one randomly selected army or navy commanded by the targeted character.

spells.name: Blade Storm
spells.effect_summary: Reduces the targeted character's Health by 2.

spells.name: Steal
spells.effect_summary: An offensive spell cast in battle on an enemy general whose country is at war with yours. Removes 25 personal gold from the target and adds 25 gold to your country's treasury. The target must have at least 25 gold.

spells.name: Stinging Nettles
spells.effect_summary: Deals 5% damage to one randomly selected unit commanded by the targeted character.

spells.name: Serpentine Swords
spells.effect_summary: Deals 5% damage to one randomly selected unit commanded by the targeted character.

spells.name: Imperial Dragon's Claw
spells.effect_summary: Deals 8% damage to one randomly selected unit commanded by the targeted character.

spells.name: Sword of Jaoz
spells.effect_summary: Gives the targeted character Maimed; kills the character instead if already Maimed.

spells.name: Hellas' Light
spells.effect_summary: Gives the targeted character Blind; kills the character instead if already Blind.

spells.name: Hypnosis
spells.effect_summary: Gives the targeted character Submissive; if already Submissive, gives Weak-Willed; if both are already present, grants +15 Loyalty, decaying by 1 per year.

spells.name: Cafea's Blessing
spells.effect_summary: Grants the targeted character +1 Charisma and +35% fertility for 365 days.

spells.name: Atheus' Blessing
spells.effect_summary: Grants the targeted character +1 Charisma and +25% fertility for 365 days.

spells.name: Kinweaving
spells.effect_summary: Transforms one non-primary-culture pop in an owned, controlled territory at the caster's location or a commanded army's location into the casting country's primary culture. Preserves religion and pop type. A shared territory cooldown prevents another transformation there for 365 days, regardless of caster.
